title: Increase horizontal plane pattern contrast

request.text: мне не хватает контрастности между горизонтальным паттерном и вертикальными , как на рефе, там очень хороший контраст. А у нас как ни меняй скейл - не получается

decision: Render lower plate top faces as a dedicated high-contrast print layer with a near-white paper tone, near-black pattern ink, and strongly reduced grain response. Keep Pattern scale responsible only for pattern feature size and preserve the independently lit vertical grid faces.
result: Horizontal plate planes now use a near-white/near-black print response independent of directional face lighting and with only 8% of shared grain. Protected feature verification and embedded visual inspection passed; canvas zoom was restored to 60%.
checks: Protected iceberg.planePatternScale browser and WebGL verification
Embedded Browser visual comparison at 60% and 80%
risks: A hard material override could flatten the horizontal surfaces; retain slight grain while removing directional lighting from the print tone.
